question_or_symptom: The plan requested latest Triton, but frozen PyTorch names a different exact Triton revision.
observation: PyTorch 411e87a93704f547e5146c74c95fa11acf13d646 pins Triton 675c59878aa2280b31f722aaf42b825fcee21de8. That commit is not an ancestor of latest Triton main cd513e2798db0f4675b3d1205c8e76eb3381a0b3; their merge base is 3bb23dde71a3679f0ae3e9c1be6dcae1f4bff462.
conclusion: Latest Triton and PyTorch-compatible Triton are distinct source lanes even though they share one repository checkout.
decision: Baseline latest Triton for the requested out-of-tree backend, retain the PyTorch pin as a separately tagged and offline-complete compatibility revision, and require an explicit compatibility matrix before choosing either in an environment build.
invalidated_assumptions: A recent PyTorch Triton pin is necessarily an ancestor of current Triton main.
